interface.title: VGG Image Annotator (VIA) 2.0.5
interface.field: Computer vision / image dataset annotation (any discipline that labels regions in images: biology, humanities, remote sensing, etc.)
interface.stage_of_work: Data preparation and labeling: making ground-truth region annotations before analysis or model training
interface.what_it_is_for: Drawing shapes over areas of interest in local images, attaching typed attribute values to each shape and to each image, and exporting them as CSV or JSON.

data.note: I added adutta_swan.jpg and wikimedia_death_of_socrates.jpg through Project panel > Add Files. The 'image annotation / face annotation' demo links on the start page were not tried. I drew 5 regions on the swan image and 2 on the Socrates painting, and the exports came out as via_region_data.csv, via_region_data.json and via_project_1Nov2026_10h0m.json.

tree.general: Build a labeled image dataset in which marked areas carry structured labels, and export it for analysis
tree.specific: Load images into VIA, draw rect/circle/ellipse/polygon/point/polyline regions, fill in region and file attributes, then export CSV/JSON and save the project

features.name: Shape-tool region drawing on an image canvas
features.general: Pick a shape type, draw it over an area of interest, then select, move, resize or delete it; coordinates are kept in image pixels
features.specific: Region Shape palette (rectangle, circle, ellipse, polygon, point, polyline); drag for box/circle/ellipse, click vertices + Enter for polygon/polyline; click inside to select, drag to move, drag handles to resize, Delete Region to remove. Number-key shortcuts for the tools were not confirmed: the replay's '5' key did not switch tools
steps: drag (or click vertices and press Enter) on the image
click the region to select it
drag its body or a handle to move or resize
press Delete Region to remove it
serves_tasks: Outline an object with a box and label it
Mark areas with other shape types
Repeat the labeling on the next image, reusing an earlier shape

features.name: Attribute schema editor
features.general: Define the named fields every annotation must fill in, choose a type for each, and list allowed values with an optional default
features.specific: Attributes panel with Region Attributes / File Attributes tabs: type a name and press +, set Name/Desc./Def./Type, add option ids for dropdown types. The Type list also offers checkbox, radio and image, which were not configured
steps: pick the Region or File tab
type an attribute name and press +
for dropdown, add option ids and an optional default
serves_tasks: Define a free-text label for each marked area
Define a categorical label with a fixed list of choices
Define a label that describes a whole image

features.name: On-image and tabular annotation editor
features.general: Fill in the schema fields for the selected shape in a popup next to it, or for all shapes in a table docked below the image, plus a tab for whole-image fields
features.specific: Selecting a region opens an on-image editor next to it; Toggle Annotation Editor docks a table with one row per region and Region Annotations / File Annotations tabs; the table has −, +, ↓, ↑ and × controls, and ↑ makes it taller
steps: select a region (popup appears) or toggle the bottom editor
type text values and choose dropdown values
switch to File Annotations to fill image-level fields
serves_tasks: Outline an object with a box and label it
Fill in labels for many marked areas in a table

steps: move/resize and relabel the pasted region
serves_tasks: Repeat the labeling on the next image, reusing an earlier shape
